mdm.screen.config.main.title: Modpack Dependency Manager
mdm.screen.config.settings.hide-forced.t: Hides forced resource and data packs from the selection menu.
Enables/disables the warning screen when there are invalid dependencies. Don't disable this unless you're okay with users skipping pack downloads.
mdm.screen.config.settings.prompt-enable: Enables/disables the reload prompt that shows after successfully downloading dependencies. If disabled, the game will automatically reload.
mdm.screen.config.settings.disable-compa: Enables/disables Minecraft's version compatibility warnings for dependency packs.
mdm.screen.config.settings.button-offset: Moves the title screen button. Useful if it's overlapping with another mod's button.
mdm.screen.reloadprompt.title: Modpack Resources Downloaded
mdm.screen.reloadprompt.message.2: A reload is required to apply them.
mdm.screen.downloaderror.title: Error Downloading Modpack Resources
mdm.screen.downloaderror.message.securit: Please check your firewall and DNS configuration, and try re-launching.
mdm.screen.downloaderror.message.timed-o: Timed out while downloading modpack resources.
Resources will be downloaded on your next launch.
mdm.screen.downloaderror.message.not-fou: 404: Invalid resources could not be downloaded.
Please report this to the modpack author.
